**Timeline (optional, helps a lot)**

happen again, then ask Claude to *"call the while-you-wait debug tool"* and
paste what it returns. It holds the arcade's state, its recent events, and the
one-line descriptions of any agents running. It has no prompts or file
contents, but read it before you paste.
